name: tn10_long_prior3_poisson2
description: The four tn01_gpu PUMAs whose rare-race tract multipliers rest on about one sampled case (4703000, 4702300: R-hat ~1.07 on a tract nh_asian cell; 4702900: NH/PI tract cells; 4701900: a tract B26001 cell), with tn05's longer HMC: 32 chains, 500 warmup with a diagonal learned in Stan's windows, 4,000 samples kept every 40th (3,200 draws), started from screened draws of the whitening shrunk toward its mean only if too few pass (init_floor). Held-out tables scored (compare_variants.py). PUMA-only support with the Gaussian multiplier prior, sd 3 (+prior3, as tn05_long_prior3), and the finest cells (block group; tract for B26001) with k_hat = (estimate/SE)^2 below 2, published zeros included, pulled out of the Gaussian hierarchy as Poisson rows of their own, zeros merged coarsest first (+poisson2, pmedm_vb.assemble.poisson; step 3 of the sparse-cells plan). HMC and VB sample those rows' multipliers as zeta = b - exp(u); the VB Gaussian (in u) whitens HMC. Compare with tn05_long_prior3 and tn09_long_prior3_decor2 (compare_variants.py). Two PUMAs per GPU bundle; run_queue.py.
